transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, this is Ray Ortiz from Levittown. I noticed a strong sulfur smell near my furnace when I got home. Can someone come take a look?

This could be a gas leak, so please leave the house now and take everyone with you. Don't touch light switches, appliances or phones on your way out. Once you're outside and away from the house, call nine-one-one. Don't go back in until they tell you it's safe.
Okay, I’m leaving the house now and will call nine-one-one once I’m outside. Thanks for the advice, goodbye.
Thank you, Ray. Please stay outside and call nine-one-one as soon as you can. Goodbye.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, avoided repeated questions and jargon, and did not invent facts or promises.
